newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Modern Land soars on link-up talks.
newsitem.headline: Modern Land soars on link-up talks.

text.p: Share prices of secondary property firm PT Modern Land rose sharply by midsession on Wednesday on market talk of a possible link-up with foreign partners, brokers said.

At the break, the stock was up 17.33 percent to 2,200 rupiah after touching a high of 2,250 rupiah earlier. It was the most active stock during the morning session with about 17.3 million shares changing hands.
"I heard it might link up with a Japanese partner," a broker with a major local firm said.

He added that other rumours floating in the market had the firm receiving major orders from Singapore for some of its property projects following a government rule last year to allow foreign investors to buy property in Indonesia.
Company officials were not immediately available for comment.
The rise in Modern Land also triggered buying in sister firm Modern Bank, which rose 125 rupiah to 2,075 rupiah with about 717,000 shares traded, brokers said.
But some brokers attributed the rise in Modern Bank partly to bargain-hunting in the banking sector after recent sharp falls following news that the central bank was moving to curb loan growth.
